target_module: src/render/instanced-units.ts (proposed; no src/fight or origins module fits client rendering)
best_idea: Key the draw calls on mesh, shader and pass flags only; put each unit's matrix, colour, team colour, alpha and frame in a per-instance buffer, and draw each key once per pass in a fixed pass order.
decision_why: Keying draw calls on mesh and pass, with per-unit colour and team colour in instance data, makes the draw count scale with mesh types rather than unit count, which fits crowds in zones; the donor's translucent order (first use, not depth) must be fixed and its creature clips do not transfer.
acceptance: A dev counter shows that N units of one model with different team colours produce one instanced draw call per pass, that adding a unit of a second model adds exactly one call, and that translucent effect instances are drawn after all opaque instances in every frame.
